Dear Meridian Freight team,

Meridian Freight's platform is the kind of logistics software I already work next to. I am a software engineer with two years of experience in TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

At Tessellate Labs I built the invoicing service for our logistics clients and cut the nightly reconciliation job from 41 minutes to 6. I also built React admin screens and moved four services to Docker Compose.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
